title: Anesthesiologists
description: Administer anesthetics and analgesics for pain management prior to, during, or after surgery.

tasks.text: Examine patient, obtain medical history, and use diagnostic tests to determine risk during surgical, obstetrical, and other medical procedures.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Patient physical assessment is hands-on clinical work

dwas.name: Examine patients to assess general physical condition.

tasks.text: Administer anesthetic or sedation during medical procedures, using local, intravenous, spinal, or caudal methods.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Anesthesia administration is high-risk hands-on clinical act

dwas.name: Administer anesthetics or sedatives to control pain.

tasks.text: Record type and amount of anesthesia and patient condition throughout procedure.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Patient history requires live elicitation and judgment

dwas.name: Record patient medical histories.

tasks.text: Monitor patient before, during, and after anesthesia and counteract adverse reactions or complications.
tasks.rationale: decision support — In-procedure patient monitoring is hands-on clinical work

dwas.name: Monitor patient conditions during treatments, procedures, or activities.

tasks.text: Decide when patients have recovered or stabilized enough to be sent to another room or ward or to be sent home following outpatient surgery.
tasks.rationale: decision support — AI aids chart review; clinical observation of patient is human

dwas.name: Monitor patient progress or responses to treatments.

tasks.text: Coordinate administration of anesthetics with surgeons during operation.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Treatment planning collaboration is accountable clinical work

dwas.name: Collaborate with healthcare professionals to plan or provide treatment.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Position patient on operating table to maximize patient comfort and surgical accessibility.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physically positioning patients for exams

dwas.name: Position patients for treatment or examination.

tasks.text: Coordinate and direct work of nurses, medical technicians, and other health care providers.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Patient care supervision is live clinical leadership

dwas.name: Supervise patient care personnel.

tasks.text: Provide and maintain life support and airway management and help prepare patients for emergency surgery.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — ALS requires hands-on airway, drugs, defibrillation

dwas.name: Implement advanced life support techniques.
Prepare patients physically for medical procedures.

tasks.text: Confer with other medical professionals to determine type and method of anesthetic or sedation to render patient insensible to pain.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Treatment planning collaboration is accountable clinical work

dwas.name: Collaborate with healthcare professionals to plan or provide treatment.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Manage anesthesiological services, coordinating them with other medical activities and formulating plans and procedures.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Treatment planning collaboration is accountable clinical work

dwas.name: Collaborate with healthcare professionals to plan or provide treatment.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

dwas.name: Direct healthcare delivery programs.

tasks.text: Place invasive intravascular monitors into patients.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Medical equipment operated hands-on on patients

dwas.name: Operate medical equipment.
Administer basic health care or medical treatments.

tasks.text: Order laboratory tests, x-rays, and other diagnostic procedures.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Clinical ordering requires licensed human accountability

dwas.name: Order medical diagnostic or clinical tests.

tasks.text: Inform students and staff of types and methods of anesthesia administration, signs of complications, and emergency methods to counteract reactions.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Provider training is clinical, hands-on, accountable

dwas.name: Train medical providers.

tasks.text: Diagnose illnesses, using examinations, tests, and reports.
tasks.rationale: decision support — AI suggests differentials; clinician examines and owns diagnosis

dwas.name: Diagnose medical conditions.

tasks.text: Teach anesthesiology principles to residents.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Technology teaching needs live human demonstration

dwas.name: Teach others to use technology or equipment.
Teach medical procedures to healthcare personnel.

tasks.text: Provide medical care and consultation in many settings, prescribing medication and treatment and referring patients for surgery.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Clinical referral judgment needs licensed human accountability

dwas.name: Refer patients to other healthcare practitioners or health resources.
Prescribe treatments or therapies.
Prescribe medications.

tasks.text: Instruct individuals and groups on ways to preserve health and prevent disease.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Wellness advice needs tailoring and clinical accountability

dwas.name: Provide health and wellness advice to patients, program participants, or caregivers.
dwas.gwa_name: Providing Consultation and Advice to Others

tasks.text: Conduct medical research to aid in controlling and curing disease, to investigate new medications, and to develop and test new medical techniques.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Literature review aided; wet-lab and clinical research human

dwas.name: Conduct research to increase knowledge about medical issues.

tasks.text: Schedule and maintain use of surgical suite, including operating, wash-up, waiting rooms, or anesthetic and sterilizing equipment.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — AI schedules facility use; human resolves conflicts

dwas.name: Schedule medical facility use.
